usedFor: Shopify holds the store orders and Kommo holds your CRM, so “Order Cancelled” can add a record through “Create Company”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Create Company” in Kommo
bestTemplate.why: A cancelled order leaves a buyer worth keeping, and the action creates the company in your Kommo account.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify is polling, so a Kommo company made from it arrives after a scheduled check.
